user_story: As a guest, I want booking creation to fail if any required field is missing so that incomplete bookings are not saved.

positive.title: Successfully create a booking with all required fields filled
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page
Fill in all required fields (e.g., name, date, time, number of guests)
Click on the 'Create Booking' button
positive.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and a confirmation message is displayed

negative.title: Attempt to create a booking without providing a name
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page
Leave the name field empty
Fill in all other required fields
Click on the 'Create Booking' button
negative.expected_result: Booking creation fails and an error message is displayed indicating that the name field is required

negative.title: Attempt to create a booking without providing a date
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page
Fill in a name and all other required fields
Leave the date field empty
Click on the 'Create Booking' button
negative.expected_result: Booking creation fails and an error message is displayed indicating that the date field is required

edge.title: Attempt to create a booking with maximum character limit in the name field
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page
Fill in the name field with the maximum allowable characters
Fill in all other required fields
Click on the 'Create Booking' button
edge.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and a confirmation message is displayed

edge.title: Attempt to create a booking with an invalid future date
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page
Fill in the name field
Choose a date that is too far in the future
Fill in all other required fields
Click on the 'Create Booking' button
edge.expected_result: Booking creation fails and an error message is displayed indicating that the date is not valid
